content: Ubholu kwa Sadi

“Kwaka mtumika wa kunani kumahunde wa ku likanisa la ku Sadi ulembaje ana: “Ghangani nde malobhi ghaki jombi joabhi na Roho saba yaka Chapanga na ndondwa saba. Naghamanyi matendu ghaku, manyi kubha ubhi na lihina la kubha mwome, nambu upotile!
Ukeshaje! Ughakangamalishaje mambu ghaghahighalile, ghala ghaghabhi pambipi kupotela. Kwa ndandi mbaka sajenu ngachenaghaweni matendu ghaku kubha ghatei kukamilika palongi jaka Chapanga wangu.

Ukombukaje ghala ghaukajopalile, na ghala ghaukajowine. Ughakamula ghanihagha na kung'anambuka na kughaleka mahoku. Nambu nangakukesha, ananukuhikila ngati mwihi, wala ngawimanyi lisaa panihika kwaku.
Nambu ubhi na bhandu bhachokopi mu Sadi, bhandu ambabhu ngachebhihakihi ingobhu yabhu. Bhombi anabhajendaje papamu na nepani koni bhawati ingobhu yabhu ihuhu, kwa ndandi bhatei kupalika.

Jombi joayiwezaje anaawatikwaje ingobhu ihuhu ngati bhanihabha, nganalihunguli lihina laki mu chitabu cha womi ng'o, nanatu ananilijetakyaje lihina laki palongi ja Atati wangu na palongi ja bhatumika bhaki bha kunani kumahunde.
“Jola joabhi na makutu na ajowanaje malobhi ghani ambaghu Roho aghapwaghi makanisa!”
Ubholu kwa Filadefia

“Kwaka mtumika wa kunani kumahunde wa ku likanisa la ku Filadefia ulembaje ana: “Ghangani nde malobhi ghaki jombi joabhi mhuhu na joabhi wa chakaka na joabhi na ufunguo waka Daude na pahoghola ndyangu njeta mundu joaweza kujighila na pajighila ndyangu njeta mundu joaweza kuhoghola.

Naghamanyi matendu ghaku. Lingalyaje, nukuhoghuli ndyangu palongi jaku, ambau njeta mundu joaweza kuujighila. Manyi kubha ubhi na makili machokopi, nambu utehi kulitii lilobhi langu, wala ngachewalikaniki lihina langu.

Lingalyaje! Nukupeke bhandu bhala bhabhabhi bha lipogha laka Shetani, na bhala bhabhaliloha nde Bhayahude, nambu nga Bhayahude, nambu bhapwagha upuhe. Chakaka ananabhaleta kwaku bhakuchikamyaje na bhandu bhokapi anabhamanyaje kubha nepani ndehi kukupala.
Kwa kubha ukamwi amuli yangu kwa uhinakilu, nepani nanatu ananukulendaje mu chikahi cha mang'ahiku chechihika mu ndema wokapi, kubhalenga bhandu bhokapi bhabhatama pundema.
Nhika manyata. Ukamulakya namaa cheubhi nachu, nahuli mundu jokapi ngayinyaghula litaji laku.

Jombi joayiwezaje ananuntendaje kubha nguzu mu Nyumba jaka Chapanga wangu, wala ngayipiti kabhete monihomu ng'o. Ananemba panani jaki lihina laka Chapanga wangu na lihina la muchi waka Chapanga wangu, yani Yelusalemu wahenu, ghouhelela kuhuma kunani kwaka Chapanga wangu. Bhelabhela panani jaki ananembaje lihina langu lahenu.
“Jola joabhi na makutu na ajowanaje malobhi ghani ambaghu Roho aghapwaghi makanisa!”
Ubholu kwa Laodikia

“Kwaka mtumika wa kunani kumahunde wa ku likanisa la ku Laodikia ulembaje ana: “Ghangani nde malobhi ghaki jombi joabhi Amina, mlandilu ndongwana na wa chakaka, jombi nde utumbulilu wa hindu yokapi yeabhombiki Chapanga.
Naghamanyi matendu ghaku ghokapi. Nukumanyi kubha nga wa imbepu wala nga wa moto. Ikabya mbanga ngati ukabhi imbepu au moto!
Bhela, kwa kubha ubhi umpyou, wala ngacheubhi imbepu wala moto, mili pambipi kukutapika upitaje mu ndomu wangu!

Kwa ndandi upwagha, ‘Nepani nde mwana hindu yamaheli, mili na kila chindu, wala ngachembala chindu chokapi chela.’ Nambu ngacheumanyi kubha wehapa nde mnyonge, na upalika kubhonewa chiha, wenga nde kahochu, ngalola, na kabhete ubhi heu.

Kwa ndandi jeniheji nukupwaghila, uhemala kwangu zahabu jejigholuliki kwa moto, upata kubha na hindu yamaheli. Bhelabhela mbanga uhemala ingobhu ihuhu upata kuwata na kuyekalela iyoni ya utopu waku. Bhelabhela uhemala mitela ja kulipaka mihu ghaku, nahuli upata kulola.
Mundu jokapi jonumpala nepani nundakalila na kundapula, bhela ubya na ukangamalu wa kung'anambuka na kughaleka mahoku ghaku.
Lingalyaje! Nyema pundangu na kuhodima. Ngati mundu anaajowini sauti jangu, na kuuhoghola ndyangu, ananyingala kwaki na kula chilebhi papamu naku, najombi anaakulaje papamu na nepani.
Jombi joayiwezaje, ananuntenda atamaje papamu na nepani pa chiteu changu cha kikolongwa, ngati nepani monawezile na kutama papamu na Atati wangu pa chiteu chaki cha kikolongwa.
“Jola joabhi na makutu na ajowanaje malobhi ghani ambaghu Roho aghapwaghi makanisa!”
